versions.subject: Create win_susp_service_dacl_modification.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'sdset'
        - 'D;;'
sids:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ';;;IU'
        - ';;;SU'
        - ';;;BA'
        - ';;;SY'
        - ';;;WD'
condition: selection and sids

versions.subject: Add missing OriginalFileName
versions.detection:
selection_sc:
    - Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'sc.exe'
selection_sdset:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'sdset'
        - 'D;;'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ';;;IU'
        - ';;;SU'
        - ';;;BA'
        - ';;;SY'
        - ';;;WD'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\sc.exe" OR OriginalFileName="sc.exe" CommandLine="*sdset*" CommandLine="*D;;*" CommandLine IN ("*;;;IU*", "*;;;SU*", "*;;;BA*", "*;;;SY*", "*;;;WD*")
